svg.title: Choice as recurrent control
svg.desc: Figure 10. Three functional groups—sensory/body signals, expected outcomes, and action tendencies—are joined by recurrent curves. Food and water remain separately identified. Below, a mouse drinks from a stream beside available food and shelter. An approach-and-drink connection links action tendencies to the scene. A hydration-changes connection runs beneath the scene to a bodily-condition panel, where an initial water deficit gives way to reduced water need as fluid balance improves. Body signals and sensory evidence connect the physical setting back to the upper groups, completing the continuing loop. The diagram is labeled Conceptual synthesis.
